turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar, ye sab sunke bohot bhaari lag raha hoga. 2 baje raat ko office mein akela, aur samne haqeeqat ki ye taaleem...

Paanch saal kisi cheez mein dene ke baad, usse aise khatam hona dekhna bohot dard hota hai. Bas business nahi, ye apna hi ek hissa lagta hai jo toot raha hai. Rohit aur Sneha ne jo kiya wo practical tha, par unke jaane se ye sab aur akela kar raha hoga tumhe, sach mein?

Tumne salary nahi li, runway bachaya hai... ye sab dikhata hai ki tumne kitna de diya hai, par kabhi kabhi haara hua mehsoos karna bhi zaroori hota hai.

Abhi ke liye bas wahi baitho. Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi, sirf saans lo. Tumhare paas chaar mahine hain, unmein sochna hai. Aaj ke liye bas ye sukoon chahiye ki tumne jo kiya, wo dil se kiya.

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Ye "acting" karna sabse bada emotional drain hai, samajh raha hoon. Har din uthke ek script padhna, aur audience ko pata bhi hai ki story khatam ho chuki hai. Wo "confidence" wali awaaz andar se kaise nikalti hogi, ye sochke hi dard hota hai.

Aur wo dono juniors... unke liye jo guilt mehsoos kar rahe ho, wo bohot heavy hai. Wo loyalty ki wajah se hain, tumhe lagta hai tum unki zindagi barbaad kar rahe ho. Par yaar, wo bhi dekh rahe hain sab kuch—tumhari mehnat, tumhari ladaai. Wo wahan sirf salary ke liye nahi hain, shayad tumhare liye hain. Haan, unka future dar lag raha hoga, par ye sab tumhara fault nahi hai.

Ghar pe alag, office pe alag... ye awaazon ka bhoot sach mein thakata hai. Aaj ke liye bas ek hi awaaz sunlo—apni apni. Jo bhi ho, ho. Abhi kuch dikhane ki zaroorat nahi hai, na hi sunne ki.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Samajh gaya. Bilkul nahi dunga ideas. Koi strategy nahi, koi 'next step' nahi, koi gyaan nahi.

Tumne jo bola—**"mujhe darr lag raha hai"**—ye sunke dil kharosh ho gaya. Kyunki ye darr sirf paisa ya naukri ka nahi hai na? Ye darr us 5 saal ki mehnat ke dube jaane ka hai, apni pehchaan ke khilone jaane ka hai.

Tumne mask pehen rakha hai har jagah, par andar bohot zor se gudgud raha hai. Tumhare liye ye sab kisi ke saamne kehna mushkil hai kyunki tumhe lagta hai sabse expect kiya jata hai ki tum "strong" ho, tum "solution" nikaloge.

Par yahan, mere saath, tum mask utaar sakte ho. Tum darr sakte ho. Tum haara hua mehsoos kar sakte ho. Koi judgement nahi hai, bas main yahan hoon sunne ke liye ki haan, ye sab bohot kathin hai.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Yaar, sach bolun toh... haan, us cheez ke khatam hone ki awaaz aa rahi hai jo tumne 5 saal pehle shuru ki thi. Wo josh, wo sapna, wo "computer ka business" jo Papa ko itni pride deti hai—woh zameen par aa chuka hai.

Papa ko nahi pata, kyunki tumne unhe apne shoulders pe utha rakha hai. Wo dekh rahe hain jo tum unhe dikhana chahte ho, par tum andar dekh rahe ho ke sheeshe ke tukde tukre ho rahe hain.

Wo "khatam ho jaye" ki soch ke liye khud se nafrat mat karo. Ye buri baat nahi hai. Ye sirf darr se azaadi chaahne ki awaaz hai. Tum bas us darr se chutkara chahte ho, wo acting band karna chahte ho.

Wo dashboard... wo do baje kuch naya bolega. Wo sirf wahi dikhayega jo tumhara dil jaanta hai. Wo bas ek tasalli hai jo ab kaam nahi kar rahi. Bas band kar do usko aaj. Kuch nahi badlega ab refresh karne se.
